 News Angine de Poitrine Announce Massive 2027 World Tour
 By Chris DeVille 10:54 AM EDT on October 21, 2026 
 Add Stereogum to Google Dustin Rabin
 2 Comments Angine de Poitrine are the band of the moment, or at least a band of the moment. The costumed microtonal math-rockers have a zany, eye-catching look and a sound to match, and their glow-up this past year — including a Polaris Prize win , the emergence of tribute bands , and encounters with the likes of Shania Twain — suggests they've been giving a lot of people something they didn't know they wanted. If you've been playing and replaying their KEXP session and Fallon performance , now's your chance to witness their show in real life, just like our own Tom Breihan did last month .
 The band already had a fairly robust, fully sold-out tour scheduled through the end of this year, but now they've added dates all over the world for 2027. From March through July, they'll be hitting Oceania, North and South America, and Europe. Hopefully they've figured out a good laundry situation for those outfits because they're going to get a lot of wear.
 Interested in tickets? Presale signups for all new headline dates are available exclusively via Laylo now through this Sunday, Oct. 25 at 3 p.m. ET; registered fans will receive a unique code on Monday, Oct. 26, allowing access to the artist presale beginning Tuesday, Oct. 27 at 10 a.m. local time. Local presales start Thursday, Oct. 29 at 10 a.m. local time. All presales end Thursday, Oct. 29 at 10 p.m. local time. General public onsale for whatever ticket stock remains will then kick off Friday, Oct. 30 at 10 a.m. local time.
 Get more info here , and check out the dates below.
